I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message: "Thanks, Hollis. Noted that you're on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile. If anything for you comes up here, I'll point people to your mobile."

His message was an availability notice, not a request, so that reply is all I did. I didn't send any mail or approval requests, and I didn't change his calendar.
